item.text: {"verdicts":[{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E001","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E002","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E003","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"LAMUKA criticized Tshisekedi for relying on East African forces and approaching South Sudan’s army, characterizing this as a risky approach and calling for reliance on Congolese security forces.","notes":["The excerpt supports LAMUKA’s attribution and criticism, but not the broader characterization that this was a short-term policy."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E004","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E005","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E006","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E007","status":"corrected","corrected_fact_summary":"In March 2023, Goma residents and observers identified removing the M23 and ADF as major security challenges; residents said the end of hostilities could allow hundreds of thousands of displaced people to return, and one resident said security had been deteriorating for at least 23 years.","notes":["The excerpt attributes the 23-year deterioration claim to one anonymous resident, not residents and observers collectively."]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E008","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E009","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]},{"evidence_id":"BATCH-0005-E010","status":"accepted","corrected_fact_summary":null,"notes":[]}]}
